body: @gkalpak I can take a look at this.

@StephenFluin / @IgorMinar I see that the stackblitz url in the file:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angular/angular/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/1-bug-report.md

points to:

https://stackblitz.com/fork/angular-issue-repro2

Do you know whether this repo was created using an account owned by angular? 
Should we actually be using https://stackblitz.com/fork/angular-ivy ?
It should be this one, you're right: https://stackblitz.com/fork/angular-ivy

@StephenFluin Thanks for confirming.

Do we want to update the `index.html` to that repo with the same instructions from the old repo?

https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-issue-repro2-lx8p9a?file=src%2Findex.html

If so, how can we do that? The link to the angular-ivy URL is the link provided by stackblitz.

I'm not sure. We have some of this information in the bug template now, so
some of it isn't relevant. Reminders about minimal reproductions are
helpful though, but I'm not sure if it's worth maintaining a separate
stackblitz repro fork.
